name: Mosaic Mosque
summary: A mosque is cut into a broad eight-point tile, with one warm entrance at its center.
why: The eight-point outline recalls Islamic geometric tiles. A large mosque-shaped opening makes the building part of the negative space, while a single gold entrance adds a welcoming focus. The open cutout survives one-color export.
risk: At 24 pixels the mosque and tile merge into an intricate badge. It works best for an identity that values ornament as well as immediate recognition.
sub1: A connection to Islamic geometric craft
sub2: A place of prayer held within the pattern
reasonToChoose: You want mosque architecture and Islamic ornament in one compact seal.

palette.name: MOSAIC MOSQUE / TILE BLUE + IVORY + GOLD
